pitfalls.title: initial_routing_facts_require_code_confirmation
symptoms: routing facts are broader than verified code behavior
future agents treat bootstrap anchors as grounded implementation facts
trigger_actions: edit routing facts before sampling code
check_before_edit: read sampled code before promoting facts
keep fact_status as needs_code_confirmation until verified
safe_observation_methods: read grounding.unsampled_paths
run smallest visible smoke command

pitfalls.title: routing_files_are_machine_owned_contracts
symptoms: task_routes duplicates repo_map operational lists
routing-only changes include business code
trigger_actions: edit AGENTS.md or docs routing JSON
check_before_edit: keep routing facts in JSON owners
run evolve and validate after routing changes
safe_observation_methods: python3 skills/ai-hermes-self-evolve/scripts/evolve_ai_routing.py --routing-only --changed-file <path> --json
python3 skills/ai-hermes-self-evolve/scripts/validate_ai_routing.py

pitfalls.title: adjusted_nav_required_for_meaningful_metrics
symptoms: TotalReturn, drawdown, NewHighRatio, NetEquitySlope, and rolling price indicators disagree with expected product performance
corporate actions, distributions, or unit-value changes appear as false gains/losses
OHLC columns are not on the same adjustment basis as close/log_return
full-sample adjusted prices leak future split/dividend/distribution factors into historical signals
check_before_edit: confirm close_price_df is adjusted NAV/adjusted close
confirm adjusted NAV/close factors are point-in-time as of each output date
confirm log_return_df is derived from the same adjusted close series
confirm open/high/low use the same adjustment basis as close
avoid interpreting volume metrics for products without real volume
safe_observation_methods: inspect caller data construction before metric calculation
compare a known distribution/split date against adjusted and unadjusted series
use run_metrics_job.py with data_contract.adjustment_asof=point_in_time for adjusted price/NAV jobs
run a small single-product smoke calculation on adjusted NAV

pitfalls.title: rolling_open_close_argument_order_mismatch
symptoms: rolling indicators that use close price behave as if open price was used
AR/BR/DKX style indicators use swapped open/close inputs
manual recalculation does not match compute_all_rolling_metrics output
trigger_actions: compare rolling outputs to external technical-analysis libraries
check_before_edit: verify CalRollingMetrics constructor argument order before changing callers
add a tiny OHLC fixture where open and close intentionally differ
compare CloseMA, EMA, AR, BR, and DKX against hand calculations
safe_observation_methods: read metrics_factory.py call to CalRollingMetrics
read rolling_metrics_cal.py __init__ assignment of price_array/open_array
prefer ${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills/metrics-factory/scripts/run_metrics_job.py for rolling execution because it calls CalRollingMetrics with keyword arguments
run py_compile before and after any fix

pitfalls.title: eod_features_require_shift_for_same_day_trading
symptoms: backtest uses metrics dated t to trade before t close
signals look unrealistically strong because t close/high/low/volume/log_return is already included
model features are not shifted before same-day open or intraday decision timestamps
trigger_actions: calculate period metrics for model features
calculate rolling metrics for model features
join MetricsFactory outputs to same-day labels or same-day orders
prepare backtest features without declaring signal_timing
check_before_edit: treat outputs dated t as end-of-day features that include t row inputs
use signal_timing=eod_next_period or research_eod for safe unshifted usage
shift metric features by at least one trading row before t-day pre-close trading use
do not treat absence of future-row access as proof that same-day signal usage is safe
safe_observation_methods: compare full-data versus truncated-at-t outputs to test future-row leakage
inspect metrics_factory.py period slices and rolling_metrics_cal.py rolling windows
run run_metrics_job.py dry-run and require data_contract.signal_timing to be declared

pitfalls.title: configured_metrics_not_all_wired_to_entrypoints
symptoms: period_list contains 3y, 5y, mtd, qtd, ytd, max but no default metrics are mapped for them
30d, 35d, and 70d have metric mappings but are not in the default period_list
log_return_relative_metrics_dict and long_short_metrics are not used by current public entrypoints
trigger_actions: assume every config dictionary is executable
request relative history, BBI, DMA, DIF, DEA, MACD, or ADXSlop metrics
check_before_edit: trace config dictionary through create_period_metrics_map or create_rolling_metrics_map
confirm cal_metric dispatch exists before claiming support
distinguish default period_list from explicitly passable p_list values
safe_observation_methods: static-parse metrics_cal_config.py instead of importing when NumPy runtime is broken
read metrics_factory.py loops for p_list/period_list and roll_list behavior
run py_compile as a minimum smoke check

pitfalls.title: unchecked_python_runtime_can_fail
symptoms: importing NumPy or Pandas fails with incompatible architecture or missing dependency
py_compile passes but MetricsFactory runtime import fails
run_metrics_job.py reports runtime_import_failed under an unchecked Python
trigger_actions: run MetricsFactory with a Python that has not passed check_runtime.py
import pandas, numpy, or MetricsFactory runtime
check_before_edit: use a Python that passes ${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills/metrics-factory/scripts/check_runtime.py --project-root .
verify sys.executable and platform.machine before diagnosing code imports
do not treat default-python native import failure as MetricsFactory logic failure
safe_observation_methods: python3 ${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills/metrics-factory/scripts/check_runtime.py --project-root .
python3 ${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/skills/metrics-factory/scripts/run_metrics_job.py --project-root . --help
python3 -m py_compile metrics_cal_config.py metrics_factory.py period_metrics_cal.py rolling_metrics_cal.py
